title: Portfolio, consolidation and operations
subtitle: Forty-four repositories, six substrates and one person. What can be merged, what has been built twice, where the line runs that must not be crossed — and the system that keeps the whole thing running without falling apart.
scope: The map covers **43 repositories read from beginning to end** — README, documentation, code, workflows and git history; 30 of them are public and 13 private. Nine joined on 12 September 2026, and all nine are public. **This repository is public today, so the manifest — dossiers for thirteen private repositories included — is public as well**; see `risks` in the `konradcinkusz` entry. Two repositories read the same way are off the map: `aurelius-promptus`, withdrawn until a security gap the audit found in it is fixed, and `quorum`, whose history carries an unrotated credential (commit `f0fca15`) in a repository that has been public since 1 September. The account holds more repositories: others are public, not archived and **are not here**, among them `DeepDiveInto_CSharp_Dictionaries_presentation` (3 stars). A repository reaches the map when someone has actually read it — not when it exists.
